title: Hypothesis Generation
intent: formative · Intellectual Depth (Thinking) · click through the process
statement: Turn an observation or theory into a specific, testable prediction — one that could be shown to be wrong.

steps.title: Observe closely
steps.text: Start from a concrete observation or a pattern in existing theory, not a hunch.

steps.title: State the pattern
steps.text: Put the relationship into words: when X happens, Y seems to follow.

steps.title: Make it a prediction
steps.text: Turn the pattern into an if–then statement you could actually test.

steps.title: Make it falsifiable
steps.text: Ensure some possible result would prove it false — unfalsifiable claims are not hypotheses.

steps.title: Define the disproof
steps.text: Say in advance what observation would make you abandon it. That is what makes it science.

feedForward.text: Write one hypothesis for your topic as an if–then sentence, and state the result that would disprove it.
